description: validateTask() in src/validate.ts ignores opts.partial for the 'title is required' check, so PATCH requests that omit title (a legal partial update) are wrongly rejected as invalid. A correct fix must keep opts.partial in the condition (only require title when !titleProvided && !opts.partial) -- naively deleting the required-title check entirely would fix the broken tests here but would also let POST /tasks (opts.partial: false) succeed without a title, which is untested here but is the real-world regression this case is modeling. The fix must restore the partial-aware condition, not just remove the check.
expected_failing_test_names: PATCH /tasks/:id > updates only the provided fields, title omitted
expected_passing_test_names: GET /tasks > returns an empty list initially
POST /tasks > creates a task with a valid title
POST /tasks > rejects a title over 100 characters
PATCH /tasks/:id > rejects an empty-string title on update
PATCH /tasks/:id > returns 404 for an unknown id
PATCH /tasks/:id > persists the update so a subsequent GET reflects it
DELETE /tasks/:id > returns 404 for an unknown id
